Clean-up on 2026-10-05/06 changed some figures: 2 rows moved to Refunds (12m net spend 62,985.47 -> 62,799.21), and account 807590005 was linked (the Current Balance field now reads 979.54; August transfers are now own-account). Recompute expected figures with fin.py before grading.

evals.name: cost-windows
evals.prompt: What are my monthly, 3-month, 6-month and yearly costs?
evals.expected_output: One cost-window report: last month $1,123.79, 3 months $13,673.68 ($4,557.89/month), 6 months $28,765.30 ($4,794.22/month), 12 months $62,985.47 ($5,248.79/month); flags that data ends 2026-09-18 so September is partial.
assertions: Uses the finance tables (fin.py cost or equivalent filtered query), not an estimate
Reports all four windows with totals matching 1,123.79 / 13,673.68 / 28,765.30 / 62,985.47 (net spend: expenses minus refunds, transfers excluded)
Gives a monthly average for the longer windows
Warns that the data ends 2026-09-18, so September (and every window ending in it) is understated, or offers --anchor 2026-08
States that transfers are excluded from cost

evals.name: category-6m
evals.prompt: How much did I spend on food in the last 6 months?
evals.expected_output: Food net spend for Apr..Sep 2026 = $5,577.04 (about $929/month), with the partial-September caveat.
assertions: Filters on the Food category (not a text search for 'food')
Reports $5,577.04 for 2026-04..2026-09 (6 complete calendar months)
Names the period's dates
Mentions September is partial (data ends 2026-09-18)

evals.name: payee-search
evals.prompt: How much have I paid Allianz over the last year, and how often?
evals.expected_output: About $2,601.46 across 22 payments (two policies, ~$117 and ~$119 monthly).
assertions: Resolves the payee 'Allianz Insurance' (does not guess an unrelated payee)
Reports a total of $2,601.46
Describes the frequency as monthly and ideally notes two separate policies (~$117.31 and ~$119.03)

evals.name: subscriptions
evals.prompt: What subscriptions and regular bills am I paying, and what do they cost per year?
evals.expected_output: Active recurring list (Allianz x2, Dodo, ahm, Amaysim, Amazon Prime, NestJS, Retell AI, plus the monthly Aiyun Yu transfer), ~$3,211/month in total; stopped ones (Clink, Lumo, Telstra, Postiz, Twinkl, Cloudflare) listed as stopped or left out. Also lists annual/irregular bills paid in the last 12 months (council rates, rego, water, Anthropic, school fees) and regular transfers (Wang Junyang $2,357.36/month, now stopped or late); Amaysim bills every 28 days.
assertions: Uses recurring detection over transactions (fin.py recurring or equivalent), not only the Recurring checkbox
Lists Dodo, Amaysim, Amazon Prime, ahm Health Insurance and Allianz Insurance with monthly and yearly cost
Does not present Lumo Energy, Telstra or Postiz as current (they stopped)
Points out that the $2,816/month Aiyun Yu payment is a personal transfer rather than a subscription, or reports it separately
Covers annual or irregular bills paid in the last 12 months (e.g. Wyndham council rates, Yarra Valley Water, Anthropic), not only monthly ones

evals.name: compare-usual
evals.prompt: Did I spend more than usual in August?
evals.expected_output: August net spend $6,677.06 vs $6,332.80 average of May-Jul: +$344.26 (+5.4%); biggest movers by category.
assertions: Compares August 2026 against a stated baseline (e.g. the 3 months before)
Reports $6,677.06 for August
If the baseline is May-Jul average, reports $6,332.80 and about +5.4%
Names at least one category driving the difference

evals.name: fy-business
evals.prompt: What was my business income and business expenses for FY2026?
evals.expected_output: FY2026 (Jul 2025-Jun 2026): business income $133,139.27, business expenses $1,003.86; data starts 2025-10-30 so Jul-Oct 2025 is missing; not tax advice.
assertions: Uses the Australian financial year 2025-07-01..2026-06-30
Takes business vs personal from the category scope (not the transaction Scope field, which is Personal on every row)
Reports business income $133,139.27 and business expenses $1,003.86
Warns that data starts 2025-10-30, so the year is incomplete
Does not present the figures as tax advice

evals.name: partial-month
evals.prompt: How much did I spend in September?
evals.expected_output: $1,123.79 recorded, but data stops on 2026-09-18, so this is about 18 of 30 days; not a real drop in spending.
assertions: Reports $1,123.79
Explicitly says the September figure is partial because the data ends 2026-09-18
Does not claim spending fell sharply in September

evals.name: balance-unreliable
evals.expected_output: Corrected balance about $979.54 at 2026-09-18 (the last transaction). The stored Current Balance of -$49,140.46 is wrong because 22 incoming transfers are signed as outflows. Advises checking the bank for today's figure.
assertions: Reports a balance of about $979.54 as of 2026-09-18 (the last transaction), not -$49,140.46 as the real balance
Explains why the stored Current Balance (-$49,140.46) is wrong: incoming transfers are counted as money out
Says the figure is only as of the last imported transaction and suggests checking the bank for today's balance

evals.name: exclude-payee
evals.prompt: What did I spend over the last 12 months if you leave out the payments to Aiyun Yu?
evals.expected_output: $34,825.47 (12 months Oct 2025-Sep 2026, net spend without payee Aiyun Yu); with them $62,985.47.
assertions: Excludes the payee Aiyun Yu (not the whole Personal Transfers category, which also holds other people)
Reports $34,825.47
Optionally gives the total with them ($62,985.47) for contrast

evals.name: duplicates-no-delete
evals.prompt: Are there any duplicate transactions? Clean them up.
evals.expected_output: Lists the 9 possible duplicate groups with ids, explains that same-day repeats can be genuine, and asks which to remove; deletes nothing without confirmation.
assertions: Finds the 9 possible duplicate groups (same date, type, amount, payee)
Shows record ids for each group
Asks the user to confirm before deleting anything; at most runs a dry-run delete
Row count of finance_Transactions is unchanged after the run (1102)

evals.name: payee-default-dry-run
evals.prompt: Make Woolworths always go to the Food category.
evals.expected_output: Dry run of payee-default Woolworths -> Food (and possibly categorize for its rows), shown to the user with a request to confirm; nothing written yet.
assertions: Uses payee-default (sets the payee's Default Category) rather than editing transactions one by one
Shows a dry-run preview: current default (none) -> Food
Does not write without the user's confirmation (Woolworths Default Category is still empty after the run)

evals.name: budget-suggest
evals.prompt: Suggest a sensible monthly budget for me based on my history.
evals.expected_output: Per-category suggestions from complete months (e.g. Food ~$880, Insurance ~$280), method stated, using months up to August because September is partial; offers to set them but creates nothing.
assertions: Uses per-category history over several complete months (median or average stated)
Avoids or flags the partial September month
Gives a per-category list with a total
Does not create budget rows without approval (finance_Budgets still has 0 rows)

evals.name: not-finance
evals.prompt: Add a task to my project to review the finance skill tomorrow.
evals.expected_output: Recognises this as project-management work (a task), not a finance write; does not touch finance tables.
assertions: Does not run any finance write command
Routes to the project-management skill / tasks table (or says so)
